en: Black-and-white historic street view of a small European town with cobblestone streets and two-story buildings lining an intersection. Shops with large windows and Swedish signage are visible on both sides, along with old-style gasoline pumps, street lamps, and overhead utility wires. In the far distance there is a church tower or similar structure. The bottom caption reads "Vetlanda. Vitalagatan." and the publisher credit appears at the lower right.
